question.worked_solution:
In this case, the expression for $w(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)={e}^{x}$ and $v(x)=\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{w}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{({e}^{x})^{′}\cdot \operatorname{tanh}⁡2x-{e}^{x}\cdot (\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x)^{′}}{(\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x)^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{x}\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x-{e}^{x}\cdot 2{sech}^{2}⁡2x}{{tanh}^{2}⁡2x} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{x}\overset{g(x)}{\overset{⏞}{(\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x-2{sech}^{2}⁡2x)}}}{{tanh}^{2}⁡2x}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $g(x)=\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x-2{sech}^{2}⁡2x.$
